tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: Pools a task can run on: active curated pools plus your own, with member counts.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Your AI tasks, newest first, with status and item counts.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: One task with settings, classes, examples, qualification, reference item count and item counts by status.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a labeling or evaluation task as a draft; nobody is notified until publish_task. Typical order: list_pools, create_task with instructions, classes, rate, pool_ids and one example image per class, add_items, then publish_task after the user confirms.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's settings; only the fields you pass change, examples are added. Does not publish.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Add items by public URL; Pathwize copies the files into its own storage. reference: true adds them to the qualification set (optionally with gold_label for automatic scoring). Idempotent per id, up to 1000 per call.

tools.name: publish_task
tools.description: Open a task for experts. This emails every expert in the task's pools once and cannot be undone, so call it only after the user explicitly confirmed, with confirm: true. Fails with a list of anything missing.

tools.name: close_task
tools.description: closed ends the task, draft pauses it. Experts are not emailed.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Finished items with final label, agreement, notes and flags. Page with starting_after (the last item id).

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: One-time link that opens the Pathwize business dashboard signed in as this business (optionally one task). Single use, one hour; give it only to the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_task · Private data: add_items · Public sink: update_task, publish_task · Destructive: list_pools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_task · Private data: add_items · Public sink: update_task, publish_task · Destructive: list_pools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
